landing.heroHeadline: Know where every asset is, always.
landing.heroSubheadline: Register equipment in seconds, let AI propose disposal timelines, assign gear to your team, and track it all with a simple scan — no hardware required.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From purchase to disposal, in four steps
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: The same flow whether you're tracking three laptops or three thousand pieces of industrial equipment across multiple sites.
landing.step1Body: Add a name, price, and category. Brand, model, colour, or anything else specific to your business can be a custom field you define yourself.
landing.step2Body: The moment you enter a purchase price, the depreciation engine estimates scrap value, useful life, and today's book value — no spreadsheet required.
landing.step3Body: Hand it to a teammate or an outside contact. Update its location with a phone camera scan at any checkpoint — no RFID, no GPS hardware.
landing.step4Body: Automatic alerts land three days before anything is due back, and again on the day — to both the borrower and whoever assigned it.
landing.depreciationProofTitle: Real numbers, the moment you register an asset
landing.depreciationProofSubtitle: Every category carries a useful-life and scrap-value profile. Enter a purchase price and TraceHub does the arithmetic — no separate depreciation spreadsheet to maintain.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Nothing here is a bolt-on. Every module shares the same asset record, the same permissions, the same audit trail.
landing.feature1Body: Category-aware scrap value and useful-life estimates, recalculated automatically whenever price or category changes.
landing.feature2Body: Every asset gets a scannable code. Check it in or out at a warehouse, branch, or job site from any phone.
landing.feature3Body: Assign to staff or outside contacts, with automatic return-date reminders so nothing goes missing quietly.
landing.feature4Body: Super Admin, Company Admin, Manager, and Staff each see exactly what their role needs — nothing more.
landing.feature5Body: Asset value, depreciation, location history, and team activity — without exporting to a separate BI tool.
landing.feature6Body: Subscriptions billed through Flutterwave, so payment works the way your business already pays for things.
landing.trackedOpsTitle: Built for how operations teams actually work
landing.trackedOpsSubtitle: No RFID readers to install, no GPS units to budget for. A checkpoint is just a name — a warehouse, a branch, a job site — and a scan is just a phone camera.
landing.trackedBullet1: Any asset category, with fields your business actually uses
landing.trackedBullet2: Works the moment a phone can open a browser — no app install
landing.trackedBullet3: Every scan, assignment, and edit lands in one audit trail
landing.pricingTitle: Pricing that scales with your asset count
landing.pricingSubtitle: Every plan includes the full depreciation engine, QR-based tracking, and reporting. Higher tiers add room and reach.
landing.aiAssistantSubtitle: Skip the FAQ scavenger hunt — our AI assistant knows TraceHub inside out and answers in seconds.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Ready to know where everything is?
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Set up your workspace in a couple of minutes. No card required to start.
